title: Adam: 1-indexed step counter, bias correction, eps added to sqrt(v_hat)
notes: Repo hyperparameters (mogp.train_mogp / baseline_single_obj / mogp_coregionalized, all torch.optim.Adam(model.parameters(), lr=lr) with lr default 0.1): lr=0.1, betas=(0.9,0.999), eps=1e-8, weight_decay=0, amsgrad=False. No schedule, no early stopping, no gradient clipping, fixed n_iterations (default 200).
MEASURED: eps is added to sqrt(v_hat) (OUTSIDE the sqrt). The variant sqrt(v_hat + eps) diverges measurably -- see eps_inside_sqrt_max_abs_gap.

adam_n_steps.description: number of Adam steps in the trajectory

eps_inside_sqrt_max_abs_gap.description: alias of variant_inside_sqrt_max_abs_gap, kept under an explicit name because it is the single number that settles the eps-placement question

oracle_foreach_vs_single_max_abs.description: max |foreach=True - foreach=False| for a 4-tensor parameter set matching the repo's parameter layout: torch's vectorized and scalar Adam paths agree, so a numpy loop over parameter blocks is faithful

oracle_torch_adam_max_abs_f32.description: max |torch Adam - numpy reference Adam| over the whole trajectory

oracle_torch_adam_max_abs_f64.description: max |torch Adam - numpy reference Adam| over the whole trajectory

oracle_torch_adam_traj_f32.description: torch.optim.Adam trajectory on the same objective in f32

oracle_torch_adam_traj_f64.description: torch.optim.Adam trajectory on the same objective in f64

quad_a.description: curvature of the objective f(x)=0.5 sum a_i (x_i-c_i)^2

quad_f32_vs_f64_max_abs.description: max |float32 trajectory - float64 trajectory| over all 201 steps: how much dtype alone moves Adam

quad_first_step_f64.description: the first update. With v_1 = (1-b2) g^2 the bias-corrected ratio is m_hat/sqrt(v_hat) = sign(g) exactly, so every coordinate moves exactly -lr*sign(g) up to eps -- a strong 1-indexing check: a 0-indexed counter divides by 1-b1^0 = 0 and blows up.

quad_traj_x_f32.description: the same quadratic trajectory computed entirely in float32 (the repo's GP dtype)

quad_traj_x_f64.description: parameter trajectory, shape (n_steps+1, 5); row 0 is x0
quad_traj_x_f64.agreement_criterion: atol 1e-12 / rtol 1e-11 against a correct float64 Adam

rosen_traj_x_f64.description: Adam on the 4-D Rosenbrock function, lr=0.01, 500 steps. Asymmetric and badly scaled, so it exercises bias correction far more than a quadratic does.

variant_inside_sqrt_final.description: final iterate of the inside_sqrt variant

variant_inside_sqrt_max_abs_gap.description: max |variant trajectory - normative trajectory|: the WRONG variant sqrt(v_hat + eps): a different optimizer, and the gap is largest on low-curvature coordinates where v_hat ~ eps

variant_no_bias_correction_final.description: final iterate of the no_bias_correction variant

variant_no_bias_correction_max_abs_gap.description: max |variant trajectory - normative trajectory|: the WRONG variant with bias correction omitted entirely

variant_torch_stepsize_final.description: final iterate of the torch_stepsize variant

variant_torch_stepsize_max_abs_gap.description: max |variant trajectory - normative trajectory|: the algebraically identical rearrangement lr/bc1 * m / (sqrt(v)/sqrt(bc2) + eps) -- differs from the normative form only by float round-off
